description: For a seller receiving an agent payment: verify the settlement on-chain (tx confirmed, correct recipient and amount), report the payer wallet's on-chain history, screen the provided counterparty name against the EU and UN sanctions lists, and return an Ed25519-signed attestation you keep as your audit record (verifiable offline via /.well-known/attest-keys.json). Facts and proof, never a guarantee, custody or compliance verdict. Name appears only as SHA-256.

counterparty_name.description: name you know for the payer; screened against EU/UN sanctions, stored only as SHA-256

amount.description: expected amount in atomic USDC (6 decimals); optional

pay_to.description: 0x-address that should have received the payment (yours)

tx_hash.description: 0x-prefixed 64-hex settlement tx hash from the PAYMENT-RESPONSE

name: attest_settlement
